_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 69 (Stargaze) — a TMC + CCR polish sprint, Sam live throughout. TMC Builder: blank C-ID slots now pre-fill from title matches for a college that holds OR is building an ADT (#489/#490, flagged '≈ verify' — a headstart, not a C-ID claim), and the directory folded Status into the ADT column. CCR (Unified Courses): the filter bar was decluttered — Search leads + is wider, the 'Generated by' filter is gone (the ⚙ provenance badge stays), Subjects narrowed (#492); the credit/noncredit flag chips became '+ NC' / '+ CR' / 'NC type' (#493); the Disciplines filter shows the local subject codes that roll up to each discipline + a chip legend (#495); the ✨ Suggested-merges worklist got a 🔍 search box (#496). Plus scopes for the eventual unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint (#494) and the COR-upload layer (#491), and your Digital Imaging 12→1 merge was published to the catalog. NEXT: the Pending-merges tracking panel.

items.text: ✨ Suggested merges now has a 🔍 search box — type a term (e.g. 'digital imag') to jump straight to the matching merge groups instead of scrolling. (Your per-row ⛓ Merge chip still does ad-hoc merges; this is the 'find it in the worklist' path you asked for.)

CCR filter bar tidied: Search leads (top-left, wider), the 'Generated by' filter is gone (the ⚙ provenance badge on each row stays), Subjects is narrower. Pick a Discipline → it shows the local subject codes (ART, PHOT…) that roll up to it as chips, so 'discipline' vs 'subject' reads clearly.

CCR flag chips: a Credit-modal course that ALSO has noncredit members now reads '+ NC' (and '+ CR' the other way) instead of a redundant 'credit' word; the noncredit-category-mix chip is 'NC type'. The primary status is still in the Credit column.

On the TMC Builder, for a college that already holds (or is building) an ADT, blank C-ID slots now pre-fill with title-matching local courses, flagged '≈ verify' (a headstart, not a C-ID claim). Confirm or swap each before submitting.

Pick your college on the TMC Builder — every TMC shows whether you already hold that ADT: ✓ Active (live in catalog) vs ✓ Approved (CO-approved, pending activation) + ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out. Spot-check your college's badges; we're building toward a CO review tool that auto-checks courses against each TMC's C-ID requirements.

When the CO gets back to you on the pending-ADT docs: ask for the queue as a SPREADSHEET if possible (>> PDFs), and whether there's a course export WITH lecture/lab contact hours — that single file would crack the hours gap tab-wide. The COR-upload design is scoped (docs/kb-notes/tmc-adt-document-upload-scope.md); submitting college uploads, private Storage bucket.

PRIORITY: build the Pending-merges tracking panel — turn the '⟳ N edits awaiting daily sync' badge into a click-to-review list of this session's merges (target ← absorbed members) with an undo, so a curator can see / verify / revert before the daily sync. All client-side off the kb_curation overlay; no pipeline change. (The live view already FOLDS merges via passes() + the startup replay; this adds visibility + undo.)

When the merge wave settles (NOT per-merge): build the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint — close the gaps + re-sort contiguous 001,002… by title within each (canonical SUBJ4, band). Full Rule-7 re-mint, unverified-only (verified numbers frozen), ONE pass. Scope + the grounded re-key chain: docs/unverified_mid_renumber_scope.md. Mirror the UC-CUR→Z pair; dry-run first, Sam's go before apply.

TMC Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js (Sam: 'Go for A'): per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ accept · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○) + structural checklist (major ≥18 sem · ≤60 · select-counts) + a 'Ready / N issues' banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Demo Allan Hancock vs San Diego City. jsdom test. Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.

CCR data passes (queued, measure-first, own dry-run PRs): (1) the morphological-variant pass — Medical Assisting vs Assistant, the -ing/-ant/-ology family (lemmatize/stem the title token before _sug_sig); MEASURE regroup + over-merge first. (2) On Sam's go, DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 (kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title); apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase + dispatch.
